rationale: S322-tm-04-02 (laneA-s322-dupfix.jsonl) replaced k3's sixth same-template numeric item with an error-diagnosis mcq (7+24=31 misconception; correct 25) and renamed the step's variant form to 'spotTheHypError' -- a form the 'pythagorean' generator does not implement (forms: legFromHyp, ladder; both numeric, neither serves an mcq surface). The dead declaration made variants.resolver's declaration gate red and the step silently non-refreshable. Removed steps.k3.variant entirely: the authored mcq, its options, feedback and evaluator are untouched; no implemented form can truthfully refresh an error-diagnosis mcq, and redeclaring legFromHyp would resurrect the very same-template duplication S322 removed.
reopenCondition: the pythagorean generator gains an mcq-serving error-diagnosis form (redeclare it on k3), or any k3 widget edit

rationale: S322-tm-05-02 (laneA-s322-dupfix.jsonl) rewrote k3 as the inverse of k2 (cone 24pi -> cylinder 72pi) and ch1 as a compare-two-cones mcq, renaming their variant forms to 'tmConeToCylinder' and 'tmConeCompare' -- neither implemented by 'g8-tm-cone-volume' (forms: tmConeA, tmConeFromCylinder, tmConeB, tmConeContext). Removed steps.k3.variant and steps.ch1.variant: authored widgets untouched. Redeclaring k3 to tmConeFromCylinder would refresh it into k2's own cylinder->cone template, recreating the duplication S322 eliminated; no implemented form serves ch1's compare mcq.
reopenCondition: g8-tm-cone-volume gains a cone->cylinder or compare form (redeclare), or any k3/ch1 widget edit

rationale: Pre-existing at clean HEAD a78d6a3 (verified by node replica in the /tmp/mt-r3 baseline worktree): k1b declares parabola-focal/widthFromP, but the generator implements only dishForm and focusPoint, both equation->focal-length items. k1b is the deliberate FORWARD direction ('Work forward: from focus to width', answer 12 = full width at height 3), so neither implemented form can truthfully refresh it and either would duplicate the sibling equation->p direction. Removed steps.k1b.variant; the authored numeric item, commonErrors and explanationVariants are untouched. This was the first-failing (fail-fast) declaration in variants.resolver's gate, listed in S325_NEW_PLATFORM_REDS.txt.
reopenCondition: parabola-focal gains a widthFromP (p->width) form (redeclare it on k1b), or any k1b widget edit
